ActAnswer.description: `{"action": …, "ids": […]}`: what was done, and what was skipped and why.

ApiAnswer.description: `{"api": true}` / `{"api": false}`: the API's new state.

added.description: When it was added, as the list shows it; null for downloads from before that column.

error.description: Why it failed, for a download in `Error`.

id.description: What the actions take (`ids`); never reused.

path.description: Where it is saved: the file, or a torrent's folder.

size.description: Its size in bytes; null while unknown.

speed.description: Bytes per second; 0 when it isn't running.

url.description: Its address (a video's page, a torrent's magnet link).

ErrorAnswer.description: An unknown question or action, or a question while the API is off.

code.description: For programs: `"api-off"` while the API is off.

error.description: For people; its wording may change.

ListAnswer.description: `{"query": "list"}`: every download, and the total speed.

speed.description: The total download speed, bytes per second.

Request.description: One request line: the token from ipc.json and the command's fields.

action.description:
Automation API: `"pause"`, `"start"`, `"remove"` (off the list, its file kept) or
`"delete"` (with its file) the downloads `ids`; answered with what was done and skipped.

api.description: Automation API: turn it on or off.

exclude_site.description:
From the browser's toolbar button: leave this site's downloads (a host name) to the
browser from now on (Options → File types → excluded sites).

exit.description:
`/exit` (beyond IDM): the running app saves and quits (the installer, before an upgrade
or an uninstall). Starts nothing when no app runs.

final_url.description:
From the browser: where its redirects from `url` ended (`url` stays the address asked
for, so an expired signed link can be renewed from it).

later.description: `/a`: add to the main queue, don't start.

links.description:
From the browser's right-click menu: the links of a page or a selection, offered in the
list window to pick from (the browser's `referer` and `cookies` go with them).

panel_hide_site.description: From that button's menu: never show it on this site (a host name) again.

post.description:
From the browser: a form's download, re-sent as a POST with this body and its
Content-Type (`post_type`).

private.description: From a private (incognito) window: the download is never written to the saved list.

proxy.description:
From the browser (#42): the proxy it uses for this address ("http://host:port",
"https://…", "socks5h://…", "socks4://…"), set by a VPN or proxy extension or its
settings; or its proxy auto-config script's text. The app downloads through the same
one (Options → Proxy / Socks → "Use proxy/socks from a browser's request").

proxy_login.description:
That proxy asked the browser for a login, which the extension that set it answers with
its own: no other program can have it.

query.description: Automation API (off by default, beyond IDM): `"list"` asks for every download as JSON.

referer.description: From the browser: request context to reuse.

show.description:
`/show <window>` (beyond IDM): the running app opens one of its windows by name, for
screenshots and scripted checks (tools/lab/docs-shots.ps1): `addurl`, `batch`, `find`,
`scheduler`, `about`, `language`, `shortcuts`, `speedlimit`, `properties`, `delete`,
`progress`, `existing-files`, `video-page`, `video-helpers`, `video-subs`,
`torrent-settings`, `options[:general|types|saveto|downloads|connection|proxy|logins|sounds|regional|panels]`.

silent.description: `/n`: silent — no Download File Info dialog.

size.description: From the browser: the size and type its own download had (no need to look them up).

token.description: The `token` from ipc.json (it changes at every start of the app).

video_page.description:
From the browser's download button over a video: open the Download video window for this
page (its address; an embedded player's own).

why.description:
"no such download", "not running", "already running", "complete" or "running: pause it
first".

description: One JSON line to the port in ipc.json (on 127.0.0.1), one line back. A request is `Request`. A command (an address to add, start_queue) is answered `ok`; a question is answered with the JSON object for it (`ListAnswer`, `ActAnswer`, `ApiAnswer`) or an `ErrorAnswer`. A wrong token is answered `denied`, an app that doesn't answer within 2 seconds `timeout`. Guide: https://misterdownloadmanager.com/help/command-line.html#the-automation-api
title: Mister Download Manager automation API
